name: SWE-Evo
intro: SWE-Evo 评测编码智能体能否根据发布说明和关联 PR/Issue 上下文完成发布级软件演进。它从 SWE-bench 与 SWE-gym 的可执行种子中选择连续版本标签，经 FAIL_TO_PASS 执行过滤和人工质量复核，形成 7 个 Python 仓库中的 48 个任务；每题平均修改 21 个文件并运行 874 个测试，以问题解决率、补丁应用率和修复率同时衡量完整解决与无回归的部分进展。
org: FPT Software AI Center, University of Melbourne, Marvis AI
build_method: 版本发布转换挖掘、执行式过滤、人工质量复核
metric: Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, Fix Rate
task_type: 代码生成, Agent任务, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 发布级长周期演进、多文件修改、部分进展评分
scale: 48 个发布级任务，7 个 Python 仓库，平均修改 21 个文件、运行 874 个测试
task_type_en: Code Generation, Agent Task, Open-ended QA
build_method_en: Release-Transition Mining, Execution Filtering, Human Quality Review
eval_feature_en: Release-Level Long-Horizon Evolution, Multi-File Changes, Partial-Progress Scoring
intro_en: SWE-Evo evaluates whether coding agents can complete release-level software evolution from release notes and explicitly linked PR/issue context. It selects consecutive version-tag transitions from executable SWE-bench and SWE-gym seeds, applies FAIL_TO_PASS execution filtering and human quality review, and retains 48 tasks from seven Python repositories. Each task edits 21 files and runs 874 tests on average; Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, and Fix Rate measure complete solutions and regression-free partial progress.
scale_en: 48 release-sized tasks, 7 Python repositories, 21 files and 874 tests per task on average
metric_en: Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, Fix Rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.18470 Sections 3.1-3.2. The diagram starts from executable SWE-bench and SWE-gym seeds, selects base commits that exactly match version tags, defines the task from the delta to the next release note plus explicitly linked PR/issue text, separates the test and start-to-end gold patches, requires at least one FAIL_TO_PASS transition with no install/runtime error, and records the human alignment review that reduces hundreds of candidates to 48 tasks. Evaluation preserves Resolved Rate, Patch Apply Rate, and regression-gated Fix Rate.
